transformations: Preserve original FBX bytes; validate and share matching duplicate skin bind poses at runtime.
Use prefab material assignments instead of stale embedded FBX texture links.
Downsample selected base colors to a maximum 1024 pixels; use JPEG quality 90 for opaque maps.
Retarget existing CC0 idle/run; Unity .anim controllers are not executed or claimed as imported.
Rebuild a coherent canonical bone parent chain while preserving every bind matrix, then share it across the 14 parts.
Calibrate auxiliary reference poses and hip/leg scale; bake shoe-sole nonpenetration offline.
Mask borrowed arm/finger tracks; apply a native static rifle pose, analytic elbow hints, right-hand attachment and weapon-relative left wrist target.
Retain the authoritative friendly muzzle at actor-local (0.13, 1.39, -0.871), independent of rendering.
limitations: Candidate historical appearance; exact Taierzhuang unit issue not verified.
Static rifle hold and finger curl are project-authored poses, not a complete military animation library.
No authored aim-transition, reload-hand, crouch or death clips; analytic hand alignment is interim, not final animation quality.
FBXLoader emits five more-than-four-skinning-weight warnings and drops excess influences; affected vertex count has not been enumerated. No lossless-import claim.
Existing collision and hit proxy retained; not bone-accurate damage zones.
One character only; no 200-skinned-character performance claim.

evaluation.evidence: Normal 100v100 battlefield: Y control hides own third-person view; personal rifle fires; Y return preserves weapon/ammo; original soldier-192 AI shot recorded at simulation time 55.5293; displayed and authoritative muzzles align within 0.0001m.
evaluation.notApproved: Final historical accuracy, full military animation quality, full skinned-army performance and user quality acceptance remain unverified.
